Face Only.when_to_use: Speech is narrative (storytelling, personal anecdotes), transitional ("Now let's look at..."), or lacks any clear visual structure. This is the default fallback.

Template 1.when_to_use: Quick overview of 2–5 types where each type needs only a short label and a one-sentence key differentiator.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 32 characters
constraints.points: Max 3 points or sub-points per type
constraints.icons: Line icons required (replaceable with numbers or short-forms only)
constraints.overflow: > 4 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template 2.when_to_use: Detailed concept breakdowns where each type needs a subheading and a 2–3 individual bullet points each of length 6 to 8 words  .

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 32 characters

Template No 16 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout (speaker left, graphics right) where speech outlines a sequence of up to 4 distinct steps or concepts, each needing a short description of 6 to 10 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines
constraints.description: Max 3 lines per point; bullet pointers allowed
constraints.overflow: > 4 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 16 OG.when_to_use: Full-page layout (no speaker visible) where speech outlines a sequence of up to 4 distinct steps or concepts, each needing a short description of 8 to 15 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines
constraints.description: Max 3 lines per point; bullet pointers allowed
constraints.overflow: > 4 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 17 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout where speech introduces numbered points that require an expanded detailed explanation or supporting graphics/images for a specific list item. limited to 20 words

constraints.heading: Omit if it would exceed two lines
constraints.images: Permitted (inside the sub-text box or briefly outside it)
constraints.overflow: > 5 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 17 OG.when_to_use: Full-page layout (no speaker visible) where speech introduces numbered points that require an expanded detailed explanation for every pointer or supporting graphics/images for a specific list item. limited to 20 words additionally support bullet points

constraints.heading: Omit if it would exceed two lines
constraints.images: Permitted (inside the sub-text box or briefly outside it)
constraints.overflow: > 5 types leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 18 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout where speech follows a structured Q&A format, displaying specific questions alongside their answers.

constraints.answers: 2–3 answers per question (box extends to fit) each answer 6 to 10 words
constraints.usage: Only when both questions and answers must appear together
constraints.overflow: > 3 questions leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 18 OG.when_to_use: full page layout (No speaker visible) where speech follows a structured Q&A format, displaying specific questions alongside their answers.

constraints.answers: 2–3 answers per question (box extends to fit) each answer 6 to 15 words for each answer point
constraints.usage: Only when both questions and answers must appear together
constraints.overflow: > 3 questions leads to splitting into two plates

Template No 20 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout where speech outlines exactly two distinct types, categories, or concepts, each needing a short description(8 to 10 words) or 2 to 3 bullet points each 5 to 7 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · 4 to 5 words max
constraints.content_alignment: Description only -> center-aligned; with pointers -> left-aligned
constraints.word_limit: Description text max 4 lines upto 12 words

Template No 20 OG.when_to_use: Full-screen layout (no speaker visible) showing exactly two concepts side-by-side. each needing a short description(8 to 10 words) or 2 to 3 bullet points each 5 to 7 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · 4 to 5 words max
constraints.content_alignment: Description only -> center-aligned; with pointers -> left-aligned
constraints.word_limit: Description text max 4 lines upto 15 words

Template No 21 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout where speech outlines exactly three types or concepts, each requiring only a subheading and a supporting icon or supporting description (5 words maximum)

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 words
constraints.subheadings: Title Case · max 2–3 words inside the circle
constraints.icons: Required (can be replaced with short descriptions, but not recommended)
constraints.sub_bullets: Not supported (use Type Template No 21 OG instead)

Template No 21 OG.when_to_use: Full-page layout (no speaker visible) outlining three concepts represented by supporting icon or supporting description (5 words maximum), where concepts require brief text callouts or branching sub-pointers.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 words
constraints.subheadings: Title Case · max 2–3 words inside the circle
constraints.icons: Required (can be replaced with short descriptions, but not recommended)
constraints.sub_bullets: Not supported (use Type Template No 21 OG instead)

Template No 22 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split-screen layout displaying 5–7 categories or types, where each category needs a title and a brief description of 5 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 words
constraints.description: Sentence case · max 5 words per description
constraints.icons: Line icons required (cannot be omitted, can use numbers)
constraints.limit: Max 5 visible categories at once (if more, first two slide up)

Template No 22 OG.when_to_use: Full-screen layout (no speaker visible) displaying 5–7 categories or types, where each category needs a title and a brief description of 5–10 words.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 words
constraints.description: Sentence case · max 10 words per description
constraints.icons: Line icons required (cannot be omitted, can use numbers)
constraints.limit: Max 5 visible categories at once (if more, first two slide up)

Template No 23 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split screen template where we are showing a process or a flow or a sequence of steps where each step is 5 words long

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 4 words
constraints.icons: Not nessesary, could be numbers or icons
constraints.limit: Max 5 visible categories at once (if more, first two slide up)

Template No 23 OG.when_to_use: Full screen layout (No speaker visible) where we are showing a process or a flow or a sequence of steps where each step is 8 words long

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 4 words
constraints.icons: Not nessesary, could be numbers or icons
constraints.limit: Max 5 visible categories at once (if more, first two slide up)

Template No 24 Glass BOX.when_to_use: Displaying a statistics fact, quantitative survey results, or percentage data in a glassbox card.

Template No 24 Split Screen.when_to_use: Split Screen template Displaying a statistics fact, quantitative survey results, or percentage data upto 15 words

constraints.heading: Optional · allowed only in Split-Screen · ALL CAPS

Template No 25 Glass Box.when_to_use: Displaying company, brand, product, or organization logos/images to build brand recall.

Template No 26 Question Box.when_to_use: Displaying a single focus question, reflection prompt, or discussion prompt for learner engagement.

Template No 26 OG.when_to_use: Displaying a single focus question, reflection prompt, or discussion prompt for learner engagement. only sentence

Template No 27.when_to_use: Defining a new term, theory, framework, or dictionary-style definition.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS
constraints.definition_text: Sentence case · Continuous text or bullet pointers
constraints.processes: Do not use for sequential processes

Template No 28.when_to_use: Highlighting famous quotes, sayings, principles, or memorable statements.

Type Template No 29.when_to_use: Highlighting a key learning takeaway, conclusion, or brief definition. Does not use a header/title. must be a sentence

Type Template No 30.name: Box plate horizontal
Type Template No 30.when_to_use: Displaying up to 4 concepts, pillars, or framework elements horizontally side-by-side with subheading and description each subheading limited to 4 words discription could be running text or pointers, the word limit can be 10-15 if its running text  words per point if we are using pointers  max 3 points of length 6 words each ONLY when there is too much text to fit in simpler templates.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.subheading: Title Case (in each box) subheading is max 4 words
constraints.sub_pointers: Sentence case · max 6 words per pointer

Template No 31.name: box plate vertical
Template No 31.when_to_use: Displaying 2 or 3 vertically stacked boxes where more explanation space is needed per category, can be running text or pointers, for running text word limit is max 20 ONLY when simpler templates cannot fit the detailed text.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.sub_pointers: Sentence case maximum of 4 points each being 8 words max

Type Template No 32.name: fact/background plate
Type Template No 32.when_to_use: Structured teaching with 4–5 main points and subpointers, or providing historical context, researcher bio, or origin background, ONLY when the content is exceptionally detailed.

constraints.downweighted_status: Reserved strictly for researcher biographies, historical contexts, or origin backgrounds
constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.subheadings: Mandatory · Title Case for each main point/fact
constraints.definitions: Do not use for pure definitions

Type Template No 33.when_to_use: Presenting evidence-based findings, research facts, statistics, or data points with subpointers ONLY when high text/data density is required.

constraints.downweighted_status: Reserved strictly for evidence-based scientific findings, citations, statistics, or data points
constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.subheadings: Mandatory · Title Case for each point
constraints.sub_points: Can have multiple sub-points in sentence case

Type Template No 35.name: text glassbox
Type Template No 35.when_to_use: Split-screen layout displaying paired contrasting concepts or short statements in glassbox style ONLY when there is a significant volume of narrative text for each concept that requires multiple sentences.

constraints.downweighted_status: Do not select for simple comparisons; default to Differentiation Template 1/2 or Type Template No 20
constraints.heading: ALL CAPS 3 words max
constraints.description: short description 15 words, bulleted list, 3 points max each 4 words

Type Template No 36.name: heavy text plate
Type Template No 36.when_to_use: Detailed explanations, complex academic theories, or policy explanations that cannot be visualised using other templates. Used only as a last resort.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 32 characters
constraints.subheading: multiple subheadings, 5 words each Title Case, text in bullets 3 to 4 under each , each can have subbullets

Type Template No 40.name: image with description
Type Template No 40.when_to_use: Presentation where a specific case study, historical person, scenario, object, or story is central to the narration.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS
constraints.description: Sentence case · no trailing periods maximum 25 words/ can be pointers if pointers then 4 points of 6-7 words each, the
constraints.right_column: Dedicated case study image area (can use pointers and source tags)

Type Template No 41.name: pointers
Type Template No 41.when_to_use: Lists of characteristics, benefits, features, or standalone ideas without hierarchical complexity.

constraints.description: Sentence case · max 15 words per pointer
constraints.limit: Max 6 visible pointers before sliding up

Process Template 1.when_to_use: Simple ordered steps needing only short labels and brief explanations.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 20 characters
constraints.pointers: Bullets allowed · max 2 lines · aligned to the text
constraints.overflow: > 4 steps leads to first step sliding out

Process Template 2.when_to_use: Multi-stage reasoning or moderately detailed academic procedures; each stage needs a subheading and a descriptive explanation.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 32 characters
constraints.pointers: Can be faded to fit additional points
constraints.overflow: > 4 steps leads to first step sliding out

Process Template 3.when_to_use: Deep technical or multi-level workflows requiring headers, structured details, and multiple bullet points.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · max 32 characters
constraints.overflow: > 4 steps leads to first step sliding out

Process Template 4.when_to_use: Split-screen layout displaying a sequential process, workflow, or customer journey with step titles (1–5 words) and NO supporting description.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS
constraints.limit: Max 5 stages visible at one time (first stage slides out if more)

Differentiation Template 1.when_to_use: Simple column-based text comparison of exactly two sides. Never use for chronological or ordered content.

constraints.overflow: > 4 differences leads to splitting into two plates (first 1-2 points slide out)

Differentiation Template 2.when_to_use: Case studies or brand comparisons of exactly two sides requiring a dedicated visual/image area alongside explanation text.

constraints.content: Description and pointers below the image · max 2–3 lines

Timeline Template 1.when_to_use: Brief milestones needing only a year/timestamp and a 3–5 word event summary.

constraints.images: Text can be replaced with images

Timeline Template 2.when_to_use: Detailed chronological analysis needing time markers, event titles, and supporting descriptive bullet points.

Hierarchy Template 1.when_to_use: Node-based tree structures representing hierarchies, taxonomies, organization structures, or architectures.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS
constraints.node_text: Title Case · max 2 lines per node

Graph Template 1.when_to_use: Showing trends or performance over a continuous progression (X-axis vs Y-axis). Only use with explicit numeric data.

constraints.heading: Required · ALL CAPS
constraints.sub_points: May appear on the right side of the graph
constraints.source: Must be provided explicitly (e.g. 'Courtesy: Company Name')

Graph Template 2.when_to_use: Comparing quantities across discrete categories. Only use with explicit numeric data.

constraints.heading: Required · ALL CAPS
constraints.sub_points: May appear on the right side of the graph

Graph Template 3.when_to_use: Representing proportional distributions (parts of a whole summing to 100%). Only use with explicit numeric data.

constraints.heading: Required · ALL CAPS
constraints.sub_points: May appear on the right side of the graph

Importance Template.when_to_use: Introducing a module/concept with 5–6 subtopics, or summarizing 5–6 key outcomes/takeaways explained in a single sentence (max 12 words) focusing on practical benefits.

constraints.heading: ALL CAPS · max 2 lines · as short as possible
constraints.description: Sentence case · max 2 lines · 10–12 words per point
constraints.theory: Do not explain the entire module or include detailed theory

IMT Mind Map.when_to_use: Visually showing the overall structure of a course or module and how topics connect (used as a navigation map). divided into 3 or 4 topics

constraints.heading: FULL CAPS · at the top
constraints.subheadings: topic names are the subheadings· max 2-3 words each topic is a list of maximum 5 constituents with 3-4 words each
constraints.usage: Do not use for detailed content explanations

NMIMS Mind Map.when_to_use: Visually mapping course/topic/module  divided into 3 or 4 constutuent subtopics.

constraints.subheadings: each constutuent topic is the subheading, each subheading should have an icon
constraints.interactive: Completed segments turn green to indicate progress
constraints.usage: Do not use for concept teaching or detailed content explanations

Soft Skills Template.when_to_use: Displaying short, simple 1-2 liner concepts, takeaways, summaries, Insights, or key messages (max 15 words). Does not use a header/title.

constraints.heading: Not permitted
constraints.description: Sentence case · max 2 sentences · max 15 words total
